step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture process begins with external parking sensors sending real-time occupancy data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Firehose triggers an ingestion Lambda function every minute, which cleans and exports historical parquet data to Amazon S3 and updates real-time occupancy state in Amazon DynamoDB (configured with a 1-week TTL). SageMaker consumes historical data from S3 for machine learning model training. AWS Step Functions orchestrates model training and endpoint deployments in SageMaker as well as triggering related Lambda tasks. AWS CodeCommit maintains code repositories and CloudFormation templates, triggering deployment pipelines to update both the ingestion and API Lambda functions. User requests arrive via Amazon API Gateway to an API Lambda function, which queries SageMaker endpoints for future occupancy predictions or DynamoDB for real-time occupancy data.
